messages:
Maria Nguyen: Quick proposal — add a `compatibility_gates` field to gateway route rules so alias resolution can exclude model versions that fail compatibility constraints (ops: latency, kv-cache format, quantization level).

Maria Nguyen: Example rule:
```
route: /v1/generate
match: header:x-tenant == "acme"
compatibility_gates:
  - kv_cache_format: [v1, v2]
  - max_latency_ms: 200
  - quantization: [int8, fp16]
pin: model-alias:acme-default
```

Ajay Patel: Nice. Two q's: 1) evaluation order — do we apply gates before alias expansion or after? 2) how do we surface gated-out reason in telemetry?

Tom Gomez: I think gates should run at candidate selection time (i.e., after alias expands to candidate set). That way we can prefer cheaper variants but still respect pinning. Telemetry: emit `route.compatibility.check` with `reason` tag.

Lisa Cho: Console UX: we should show the first-failed constraint in rollout logs + an "override" toggle for SREs with audit log. Also needs a clear fallthrough path if all candidates fail (fallback alias/quarantine).

Ajay Patel: Agree on candidate-time check. For fallthrough: default behavior = fallback to `model-alias:graceful-fallback` until operator intervenes. Also propose header `X-Model-Allow-Incompatible: true` to allow manual override from trusted tenants.

Maria Nguyen: ops question — interactions with quotas/priority queues? If a compatible model is cheaper but slower, is that allowed? We should add `priority_weight` or a `cost_threshold`. Thoughts?

Tom Gomez: Good call. Add `cost_score` and `latency_score` outputs in selector so routing decider can compute final rank. Keep gates strict (pass/fail) and ranking separate.

route-bot: schema-lint: compatibility_gates schema OK; size 2KB; no conflicts with existing selectors :white_check_mark:

Lisa Cho: Also we need to update per-route dashboards: show gate pass rate, top failing constraints, affected tenants. Pager rule if >0.5% requests failing because of gates during steady traffic.

Ajay Patel: Security note: header override must be KMS-signed or limited to internal network. Don't expose to public API keys.

Maria Nguyen: I'll draft RFC with config shape, selector changes, telemetry metrics, and console mockups. Linking RFC draft: https://redwood.internal/rfc/141-compat-gates

Tom Gomez: Can you include canary plan? I want to test with a single tenant and a dedicated canary model pool first.

Maria Nguyen: Yep. I'll target a small canary, enable telemetry flags, and then gate by metrics after 24h. PR coming later today. Thanks all :rocket:

Ajay Patel: :thumbsup:

Lisa Cho: LGTM
